name: venus
description: Venus — serveur multimédia personnel léger et auto-hébergé, interface Next.js

scripts.web:build: cd web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.web:dev: cd web && VENUS_API=http://localhost:8096 npm run dev
scripts.test: cd tests && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test
